passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.1
passages.text: Ecquid, ut adspecta est studiosae littera dextrae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.2
passages.text: Protinus est oculis cognita nostra tuis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.3
passages.text: An, nisi legisses auctoris nomina Sapphus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.4
passages.text: Hoc breve nescires unde movetur opus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.5
passages.text: Forsitan et quare mea sint alterna requiras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.6
passages.text: Carmina, cum lyricis sim magis apta modis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.7
passages.text: Flendus amor meus est — elegiae flebile carmen;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.8
passages.text: Non facit ad lacrimas barbitos ulla meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.9
passages.text: Uror, ut indomitis ignem exercentibus Euris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.10
passages.text: Fertilis accensis messibus ardet ager.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.11
passages.text: Arva, Phaon, celebras diversa Typhoidos Aetnae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.12
passages.text: Me calor Aetnaeo non minor igne tenet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.13
passages.text: Nec mihi, dispositis quae iungam carmina nervis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.14
passages.text: Proveniunt; vacuae carmina mentis opus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.15
passages.text: Nec me Pyrrhiades Methymniadesve puellae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.16
passages.text: Nec me Lesbiadum cetera turba iuvant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.17
passages.text: Vilis Anactorie, vilis mihi candida Cydro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.18
passages.text: Non oculis grata est Atthis, ut ante, meis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.19
passages.text: Atque aliae centum, quas hic sine crimine amavi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.20
passages.text: Inprobe, multarum quod fuit, unus habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.21
passages.text: Est in te facies, sunt apti lusibus anni —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.22
passages.text: O facies oculis insidiosa meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.23
passages.text: Sume fidem et pharetram — fies manifestus Apollo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.24
passages.text: Accedant capiti cornua — Bacchus eris!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.25
passages.text: Et Phoebus Daphnen, et Cnosida Bacchus amavit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.26
passages.text: Nec norat lyricos illa vel illa modos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.27
passages.text: At mihi Pegasides blandissima carmina dictant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.28
passages.text: Iam canitur toto nomen in orbe meum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.29
passages.text: Nec plus Alcaeus, consors patriaeque lyraeque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.30
passages.text: Laudis habet, quamvis grandius ille sonet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.31
passages.text: Si mihi difficilis formam natura negavit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.32
passages.text: Ingenio formae damna repende meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.33
passages.text: Sim brevis, at nomen, quod terras inpleat omnes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.34
passages.text: Est mihi; mensuram nominis ipsa fero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.35
passages.text: Candida si non sum, placuit Cepheia Perseo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.36
passages.text: Andromede, patriae fusca colore suae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.37
passages.text: Et variis albae iunguntur saepe columbae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.38
passages.text: Et niger a viridi turtur amatur ave.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.39
passages.text: Si, nisi quae facie poterit te digna videri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.40
passages.text: Nulla futura tua est, nulla futura tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.41
passages.text: At mea cum legerem, sat iam formosa videbar;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.42
passages.text: Unam iurabas usque decere loqui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.43
passages.text: Cantabam, memini — meminerunt omnia amantes —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.44
passages.text: Oscula cantanti tu mihi rapta dabas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.45
passages.text: Haec quoque laudabas, omnique a parte placebam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.46
passages.text: Sed tum praecipue, cum fit amoris opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.47
passages.text: Tunc te plus solito lascivia nostra iuvabat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.48
passages.text: Crebraque mobilitas aptaque verba ioco,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.49
passages.text: Et quod, ubi amborum fuerat confusa voluptas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.50
passages.text: Plurimus in lasso corpore languor erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.51
passages.text: Nunc tibi Sicelides veniunt nova praeda puellae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.52
passages.text: Quid mihi cum Lesbo? Sicelis esse volo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.53
passages.text: O vos erronem tellure remittite vestra,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.54
passages.text: Nisiades matres Nisiadesque nurus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.55
passages.text: Nec vos decipiant blandae mendacia linguae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.56
passages.text: Quae dicit vobis, dixerat ante mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.57
passages.text: Tu quoque, quae montes celebras, Erycina, Sicanos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.58
passages.text: Nam tua sum — vati consule, diva, tuae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.59
passages.text: An gravis inceptum peragit fortuna tenorem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.60
passages.text: Et manet in cursu semper acerba suo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.61
passages.text: Sex mihi natales ierant, cum lecta parentis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.62
passages.text: Ante diem lacrimas ossa bibere meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.63
passages.text: Arsit iners frater meretricis captus amore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.64
passages.text: Mixtaque cum turpi damna pudore tulit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.65
passages.text: Factus inops agili peragit freta caerula remo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.66
passages.text: Quasque male amisit, nunc male quaerit opes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.67
passages.text: Me quoque, quod monui bene multa fideliter, odit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.68
passages.text: Hoc mihi libertas, hoc pia lingua dedit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.69
passages.text: Et tamquam desint, quae me sine fine fatigent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.70
passages.text: Accumulat curas filia parva meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.71
passages.text: Ultima tu nostris accedis causa querelis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.72
passages.text: Non agitur vento nostra carina suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.73
passages.text: Ecce, iacent collo sparsi sine lege capilli,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.74
passages.text: Nec premit articulos lucida gemma meos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.75
passages.text: Veste tegor vili, nullum est in crinibus aurum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.76
passages.text: Non Arabum noster dona capillus habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.77
passages.text: Cui colar infelix, aut cui placuisse laborem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.78
passages.text: Ille mei cultus unicus auctor abes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.79
passages.text: Molle meum levibusque cor est violabile telis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.80
passages.text: Et semper causa est, cur ego semper amem —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.81
passages.text: Sive ita nascenti legem dixere Sorores

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.82
passages.text: Nec data sunt vitae fila severa meae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.83
passages.text: Sive abeunt studia in mores, artisque magistra

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.84
passages.text: Ingenium nobis molle Thalia facit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.85
passages.text: Quid mirum, si me primae lanuginis aetas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.86
passages.text: Abstulit, atque anni quos vir amare potest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.87
passages.text: Hunc ne pro Cephalo raperes, Aurora, timebam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.88
passages.text: Et faceres, sed te prima rapina tenet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.89
passages.text: Hunc si conspiciat quae conspicit omnia Phoebe,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.90
passages.text: Iussus erit somnos continuare Phaon;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.91
passages.text: Hunc Venus in caelum curru vexisset eburno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.92
passages.text: Sed videt et Marti posse placere suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.93
passages.text: O nec adhuc iuvenis, nec iam puer, utilis aetas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.94
passages.text: O decus atque aevi gloria magna tui,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.95
passages.text: Huc ades inque sinus, formose, relabere nostros!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.96
passages.text: Non ut ames oro, verum ut amere sinas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.97
passages.text: Scribimus, et lacrimis oculi rorantur obortis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.98
passages.text: Adspice, quam sit in hoc multa litura loco!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.99
passages.text: Si tam certus eras hinc ire, modestius isses,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.100
passages.text: Et modo dixisses 'Lesbi puella, vale!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.101
passages.text: Non tecum lacrimas, non oscula nostra tulisti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.102
passages.text: Denique non timui, quod dolitura fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.103
passages.text: Nil de te mecum est nisi tantum iniuria; nec tu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.104
passages.text: Admoneat quod te, pignus, amantis, habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.105
passages.text: Non mandata dedi, neque enim mandata dedissem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.106
passages.text: Ulla, nisi ut nolles inmemor esse mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.107
passages.text: Per tibi — qui numquam longe discedat! — amorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.108
passages.text: Perque novem iuro, numina nostra, deas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.109
passages.text: Cum mihi nescio quis 'fugiunt tua gaudia' dixit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.110
passages.text: Nec me flere diu, nec potuisse loqui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.111
passages.text: Et lacrimae deerant oculis et verba palato,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.112
passages.text: Adstrictum gelido frigore pectus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.113
passages.text: Postquam se dolor invenit, nec pectora plangi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.114
passages.text: Nec puduit scissis exululare comis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.115
passages.text: Non aliter, quam si nati pia mater adempti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.116
passages.text: Portet ad exstructos corpus inane rogos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.117
passages.text: Gaudet et e nostro crescit maerore Charaxus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.118
passages.text: Frater, et ante oculos itque reditque meos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.119
passages.text: Utque pudenda mei videatur causa doloris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.120
passages.text: 'Quid dolet haec? certe filia vivit!' ait.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.121
passages.text: Non veniunt in idem pudor atque amor. omne videbat

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.122
passages.text: Vulgus; eram lacero pectus aperta sinu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.123
passages.text: Tu mihi cura, Phaon; te somnia nostra reducunt —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.124
passages.text: Somnia formoso candidiora die.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.125
passages.text: Illic te invenio, quamvis regionibus absis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.126
passages.text: Sed non longa satis gaudia somnus habet

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.127
passages.text: Saepe tuos nostra cervice onerare lacertos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.128
passages.text: Saepe tuae videor supposuisse meos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.129
passages.text: Oscula cognosco, quae tu committere lingua

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.130
passages.text: Aptaque consueras accipere, apta dare.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.131
passages.text: Blandior interdum verisque simillima verba

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.132
passages.text: Eloquor, et vigilant sensibus ora meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.133
passages.text: Ulteriora pudet narrare, sed omnia fiunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.134
passages.text: Et iuvat, et siccae non licet esse mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.135
passages.text: At cum se Titan ostendit et omnia secum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.136
passages.text: Tam cito me somnos destituisse queror;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.137
passages.text: Antra nemusque peto, tamquam nemus antraque prosint —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.138
passages.text: Conscia deliciis illa fuere meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.139
passages.text: Illuc mentis inops, ut quam furialis Enyo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.140
passages.text: Attigit, in collo crine iacente feror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.141
passages.text: Antra vident oculi scabro pendentia tofo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.142
passages.text: Quae mihi Mygdonii marmoris instar erant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.143
passages.text: Invenio silvam, quae saepe cubilia nobis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.144
passages.text: Praebuit et multa texit opaca coma —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.145
passages.text: Sed non invenio dominum silvaeque meumque.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.146
passages.text: Vile solum locus est; dos erat ille loci.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.147
passages.text: Cognovi pressas noti mihi caespitis herbas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.148
passages.text: De nostro curvum pondere gramen erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.149
passages.text: Incubui tetigique locum, qua parte fuisti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.150
passages.text: Grata prius lacrimas conbibit herba meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.151
passages.text: Quin etiam rami positis lugere videntur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.152
passages.text: Frondibus, et nullae dulce queruntur aves;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.153
passages.text: Sola virum non ulta pie maestissima mater

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.154
passages.text: Concinit Ismarium Daulias ales Ityn.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.155
passages.text: Ales Ityn, Sappho desertos cantat amores —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.156
passages.text: Hactenus; ut media cetera nocte silent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.157
passages.text: Est nitidus vitroque magis perlucidus omni

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.158
passages.text: Fons sacer — hunc multi numen habere putant —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.159
passages.text: Quem supra ramos expandit aquatica lotos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.160
passages.text: Una nemus; tenero caespite terra viret.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.161
passages.text: Hic ego cum lassos posuissem flebilis artus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.162
passages.text: Constitit ante oculos Naias una meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.163
passages.text: Constitit et dixit: 'quoniam non ignibus aequis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.164
passages.text: Ureris, Ambracia est terra petenda tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.165
passages.text: Phoebus ab excelso, quantum patet, adspicit aequor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.166
passages.text: Actiacum populi Leucadiumque vocant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.167
passages.text: Hinc se Deucalion Pyrrhae succensus amore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.168
passages.text: Misit, et inlaeso corpore pressit aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.169
passages.text: Nec mora, versus amor fugit lentissima mersi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.170
passages.text: Pectora, Deucalion igne levatus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.171
passages.text: Hanc legem locus ille tenet. pete protinus altam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.172
passages.text: Leucada nec saxo desiluisse time!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.173
passages.text: Ut monuit, cum voce abiit; ego territa surgo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.174
passages.text: Nec lacrimas oculi continuere mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.175
passages.text: Ibimus, o nymphe, monstrataque saxa petemus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.176
passages.text: Sit procul insano victus amore timor!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.177
passages.text: Quidquid erit, melius quam nunc erit! aura, subito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.178
passages.text: Et mea non magnum corpora pondus habe!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.179
passages.text: Tu quoque, mollis Amor, pennas suppone cadenti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.180
passages.text: Ne sim Leucadiae mortua crimen aquae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.181
passages.text: Inde chelyn Phoebo, communia munera, ponam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.182
passages.text: Et sub ea versus unus et alter erunt:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.183
passages.text: Grata lyram posui tibi, Phoebe, poetria Sappho:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.184
passages.text: Convenit illa mihi, convenit illa tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.185
passages.text: Cur tamen Actiacas miseram me mittis ad oras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.186
passages.text: Cum profugum possis ipse referre pedem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.187
passages.text: Tu mihi Leucadia potes esse salubrior unda;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.188
passages.text: Et forma et meritis tu mihi Phoebus eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.189
passages.text: An potes, o scopulis undaque ferocior omni,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.190
passages.text: Si moriar, titulum mortis habere meae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.191
passages.text: Ah quanto melius iungi mea pectora tecum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.192
passages.text: Quam poterant saxis praecipitanda dari!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.193
passages.text: Haec sunt illa, Phaon, quae tu laudare solebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.194
passages.text: Visaque sunt totiens ingeniosa tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.195
passages.text: Nunc vellem facunda forem! dolor artibus obstat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.196
passages.text: Ingeniumque meis substitit omne malis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.197
passages.text: Non mihi respondent veteres in carmina vires;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.198
passages.text: Plectra dolore iacent muta, dolore lyra.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.199
passages.text: Lesbides aequoreae, nupturaque nuptaque proles,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.200
passages.text: Lesbides, Aeolia nomina dicta lyra,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.201
passages.text: Lesbides, infamem quae me fecistis amatae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.202
passages.text: Desinite ad citharas turba venire mea!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.203
passages.text: Abstulit omne Phaon, quod vobis ante placebat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.204
passages.text: Me miseram, dixi quam modo paene 'meus!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.205
passages.text: Efficite ut redeat; vates quoque vestra redibit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.206
passages.text: Ingenio vires ille dat, ille rapit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.207
passages.text: Ecquid ago precibus, pectusve agreste movetur?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.208
passages.text: An riget, et Zephyri verba caduca ferunt?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.209
passages.text: Qui mea verba ferunt, vellem tua vela referrent;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.210
passages.text: Hoc te, si saperes, lente, decebat opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.211
passages.text: Sive redis, puppique tuae votiva parantur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.212
passages.text: Munera, quid laceras pectora nostra mora?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.213
passages.text: Solve ratem! Venus orta mari mare praestat amanti.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.214
passages.text: Aura dabit cursum; tu modo solve ratem!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.215
passages.text: Ipse gubernabit residens in puppe Cupido;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.216
passages.text: Ipse dabit tenera vela legetque manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.217
passages.text: Sive iuvat longe fugisse Pelasgida Sappho —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.218
passages.text: Non tamen invenies, cur ego digna fugi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.219
passages.text: Hoc saltem miserae crudelis epistula dicat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 15.220
passages.text: Ut mihi Leucadiae fata petantur aquae!
